case.label: C
case.text: Inside one account each zone name always points to the same physical zone, so consolidating both workloads into one account does guarantee co-location without any lookup step, and a candidate could argue it removes the cross-account coordination problem permanently. It fails the LEAST operational overhead constraint: migrating a database and an application between accounts is a large project, while matching AZ IDs (use1-az2) is a one-time lookup. The stem's 2021 account creation date and us-east-1 Region make independent name mapping apply, which rules out D, and AZ IDs are the documented way to coordinate zones across accounts, so B is the single best answer.
